Class HttpAuthHeaders

java.lang.Object
org.apache.pulsar.client.api.v5.auth.HttpAuthHeaders
public final class HttpAuthHeaders extends Object
HTTP authentication headers an implementation produces for an outgoing request (and, for challenge/response, the headers carrying a server's challenge) (PIP-478).

Header names are canonicalised on construction (RFC 7230 §3.2 treats them case-insensitively); get(String) is case-insensitive; asMap() returns a stable canonical-cased view.

Single value per name. This collapses to one value per canonical name: when the source map passed to of(Map) holds two entries that canonicalise to the same name (case-variants such as Authorization and authorization), the one visited last in the source map's iteration order wins. Multi-valued headers are not represented.
